changelog.title: What's new
changelog.intro: Updates ship fast - join the Discord to see what's new and chat with the community.

notes.v250Notes: Notes became a real editor: links, numbered lists, indenting, dividers and clear-formatting, on a toolbar that follows your cursor.
notes.v250Dock: The right dock gained per-widget alignment, width and order, plus a short guide the first time you open it.
notes.v250Weather: Weather was rebuilt - the hourly strip lines up with the daily card, weekdays are correct in your timezone, and setting a location is one dialog.
notes.v250Links: Quick Links and Google apps: list and grid finally match, each with its own surface and a shared add/edit dialog.
notes.v250Surfaces: One colour picker now drives every widget surface, and frost follows your theme instead of fighting it.
notes.v250Editing: Drag Mode is gone - drag straight from edit mode. Widgets come to front when clicked, and the tour was reworked.
notes.v250Under: Under the hood: the wallpaper paints instantly on a new tab, location and email permissions are no longer requested, and cross-device sync is safer.

welcome.title: Welcome to Ghiblify
welcome.body1: A Studio Ghibli–inspired new tab page. These images are generously provided for non-commercial use by Studio Ghibli. Please enjoy this labor of love, and consider supporting the studio by purchasing official merchandise and media.
welcome.body2: If you notice any issues, please report them to me. Thank you for your support!
welcome.body3: Click Next to take a quick tour of the new features.
welcome.hint: Use ← → or the dots to flip through this guide.

findGuide.title: You can come back to this guide anytime
findGuide.body1Pre: Hover the left edge of the screen - or press
findGuide.body1Post: - to open the sidebar. The Guide button at the top brings this tour right back. Look for the pulsing button there now.
findGuide.hint: The sidebar is open behind this dialog so you can see exactly where to find it later.

widgets.title: Pick your widgets
widgets.body1: Tap any icon to show or hide it on the page. Active widgets glow with the palette's accent color.
widgets.body2Pre: These same toggles live in the sidebar - hover the left edge of the screen or press

palette.title: Adjust appearance
palette.body1: Click a swatch to retint the entire UI. Light palettes flip text and surfaces dark; the Frost palette gives every widget a glass treatment.
palette.hint: Palette, font and corners all live in the sidebar's Appearance section, so you can change them anytime.
palette.body2: The same section carries Font and Corners - pick the typeface for the whole page, and how rounded every surface should be. All three are expanded in the sidebar now.

adjustTime.title: Enter edit mode
adjustTime.body1: Right-click any widget on the page to enter edit mode and open its controls.
adjustTime.body2: You can also right-click its icon in the left sidebar, then choose Edit. Both options are indicated on the Time widget now.

drag.title: Drag, resize, edit widgets
drag.body1: Use the edit panel to change the widget's settings.
drag.body2: Drag the widget itself to move it—no key needed.
drag.hint: Drag the shadowed corner grip to resize.

background.title: Select backgrounds
background.body1: Heart the current photo to add it to your favorites - favorites stay in the rotation no matter what. Trash it to never see it again.
background.body2: Open Select Backgrounds to choose which films appear, or browse and heart any photo from any film.
background.hint: The Select backgrounds button is pulsing in the sidebar - heart, trash and refresh sit beside it.

settings.title: Settings
settings.permissionsSub: Ghiblify asks for nothing up front. Turn on only what you use - revoking takes effect immediately.
settings.permissionGeolocationSub: Approximate (city-level) location from your network connection - used only to fetch the local forecast. No GPS, no location permission.
settings.permissionBookmarksSub: Lets the bookmarks panel read and organise your Chrome bookmarks.
settings.storageSub: {{count}} keys · {{size}} total. Expand a row to see its contents.
settings.resetSub: Deletes every saved setting - widgets, backgrounds, names, todos, the lot - and reloads the page.
settings.cursorSub: Puts the cursor trail back to the plain system pointer. Its setting is stored with Appearance.
settings.highContrastSub: Stronger text contrast across the whole page.
settings.parallaxSub: The wallpaper drifts gently with your cursor.
settings.deleteKeyConfirm: Delete “{{key}}” from storage? Anything it holds is gone for good.
settings.resetWidgetsConfirm: Put every widget back to its default position, size and settings? Your quick links, greeting name, notes and todo list are kept.
settings.resetDockConfirm: Put the right-hand dock back to its default layout?
settings.resetAppearanceConfirm: Put the theme, font and contrast back to their defaults?
settings.resetBackgroundConfirm: Put the background filters and parallax back to their defaults?
settings.resetCursorConfirm: Put the cursor back to the plain system pointer?
settings.otherSub: Install flags and anything not owned by a section above.
settings.permissionMicrophoneSub: Lets the search bar's voice search listen. Only active while you hold the mic button's session.
settings.cornersSub: How round widgets, menus and modals are.
